prompt: Show an OAuth login flow where a browser redirects to an authorization server, exchanges an authorization code through the backend, loads the user profile, and creates a session.
enzo:
sequence OAuthAuthenticationFlow
actor Browser
participant WebApp
participant Backend
participant AuthorizationServer
participant UserInfoApi
participant SessionStore
Browser -> WebApp: Start login
WebApp --> Browser: Redirect to authorize
Browser -> AuthorizationServer: Authorize request
AuthorizationServer --> Browser: Authorization code
Browser -> Backend: Submit callback code
Backend -> AuthorizationServer: Exchange code for tokens
AuthorizationServer --> Backend: Access token
Backend -> UserInfoApi: Load user profile
UserInfoApi --> Backend: User profile
Backend -> SessionStore: Create session
SessionStore --> Backend: Session id
Backend --> Browser: Login complete
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
actor Browser
participant WebApp
participant Backend
participant AuthorizationServer
participant UserInfoApi
participant SessionStore
Browser->>WebApp: Start login
WebApp-->>Browser: Redirect to authorize
Browser->>AuthorizationServer: Authorize request
AuthorizationServer-->>Browser: Authorization code
Browser->>Backend: Submit callback code
Backend->>AuthorizationServer: Exchange code for tokens
AuthorizationServer-->>Backend: Access token
Backend->>UserInfoApi: Load user profile
UserInfoApi-->>Backend: User profile
Backend->>SessionStore: Create session
SessionStore-->>Backend: Session id
Backend-->>Browser: Login complete

enzo:
sequence InventoryReservation
actor Storefront
participant OrderApi
participant InventoryService
participant StockDatabase
participant ReservationStore
participant Scheduler

OrderApi -> InventoryService: Reserve items
InventoryService -> StockDatabase: Check available stock
StockDatabase --> InventoryService: Stock available
InventoryService -> ReservationStore: Create reservation
ReservationStore --> InventoryService: Reservation id
InventoryService -> Scheduler: Schedule expiration
Scheduler --> InventoryService: Expiration scheduled
InventoryService --> OrderApi: Reservation confirmed
OrderApi --> Storefront: Cart reserved

actor Storefront
participant OrderApi
participant InventoryService
participant StockDatabase
participant ReservationStore
participant Scheduler

OrderApi->>InventoryService: Reserve items

prompt: Show a frontend calling an API that calls an external service, receives a transient failure, retries once, stores the successful result, and responds.
enzo:
sequence RetryingApiRequest
actor Frontend
participant Api
participant ExternalService
participant Database
participant Logger
Frontend -> Api: Submit request
Api -> ExternalService: Send request
ExternalService --> Api: 503 transient failure
Api -> Logger: Record retryable failure
Logger --> Api: Logged
Api -> ExternalService: Retry request
ExternalService --> Api: Success response
Api -> Database: Store result
Database --> Api: Stored
Api --> Frontend: Success response
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
actor Frontend
participant Api
participant ExternalService
participant Database
participant Logger
Frontend->>Api: Submit request
Api->>ExternalService: Send request
ExternalService-->>Api: 503 transient failure
Api->>Logger: Record retryable failure
Logger-->>Api: Logged
Api->>ExternalService: Retry request
ExternalService-->>Api: Success response
Api->>Database: Store result
Database-->>Api: Stored
Api-->>Frontend: Success response

prompt: Show a webhook receiver verifying an event, deduplicating it, publishing it to a message bus, processing it in a worker, and updating a database.
enzo:
sequence WebhookProcessingMedium
actor Provider
participant Receiver
participant SignatureVerifier
participant DedupStore
participant MessageBus
participant Worker
participant Database
Provider -> Receiver: POST webhook event
Receiver -> SignatureVerifier: Verify signature
SignatureVerifier --> Receiver: Signature valid
Receiver -> DedupStore: Check event id
DedupStore --> Receiver: Not seen
Receiver -> MessageBus: Publish event
MessageBus --> Receiver: Accepted
Receiver --> Provider: 202 accepted
MessageBus -> Worker: Deliver event
Worker -> Database: Apply update
Database --> Worker: Updated
Worker --> MessageBus: Acknowledge
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
actor Provider
participant Receiver
participant SignatureVerifier
participant DedupStore
participant MessageBus
participant Worker
participant Database
Provider->>Receiver: POST webhook event
Receiver->>SignatureVerifier: Verify signature
SignatureVerifier-->>Receiver: Signature valid
Receiver->>DedupStore: Check event id
DedupStore-->>Receiver: Not seen
Receiver->>MessageBus: Publish event
MessageBus-->>Receiver: Accepted
Receiver-->>Provider: 202 accepted
MessageBus->>Worker: Deliver event
Worker->>Database: Apply update
Database-->>Worker: Updated
Worker-->>MessageBus: Acknowledge

prompt: Show one service calling another service with mTLS and token introspection before the downstream service reads data and responds.
enzo:
sequence ServiceAuthentication
participant ServiceA
participant ApiGateway
participant ServiceB
participant CertificateAuthority
participant TokenIntrospection
participant Database
ServiceA -> ApiGateway: Call ServiceB with token
ApiGateway -> CertificateAuthority: Verify client certificate
CertificateAuthority --> ApiGateway: Certificate trusted
ApiGateway -> ServiceB: Forward request
ServiceB -> TokenIntrospection: Introspect token
TokenIntrospection --> ServiceB: Token active
ServiceB -> Database: Query data
Database --> ServiceB: Data rows
ServiceB --> ApiGateway: Data response
ApiGateway --> ServiceA: Data response
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
participant ServiceA
participant ApiGateway
participant ServiceB
participant CertificateAuthority
participant TokenIntrospection
participant Database
ServiceA->>ApiGateway: Call ServiceB with token
ApiGateway->>CertificateAuthority: Verify client certificate
CertificateAuthority-->>ApiGateway: Certificate trusted
ApiGateway->>ServiceB: Forward request
ServiceB->>TokenIntrospection: Introspect token
TokenIntrospection-->>ServiceB: Token active
ServiceB->>Database: Query data
Database-->>ServiceB: Data rows
ServiceB-->>ApiGateway: Data response
ApiGateway-->>ServiceA: Data response
